headlines.text: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures surge in a relief rally as Wall Street tries to claw back from last week's correction
Nvidia rockets as much as 9.7% premarket after Trump renews his push to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
Nasdaq 100 futures rip as much as 6% as AI stocks attempt to bounce back from their worst week since the 2020 pandemic crash
Nvidia's board has already ruled out reinstating Jensen Huang, leaving interim CEO Colette Kress running the chipmaker
Zoom kicks off a Thanksgiving-week earnings slate after Monday's close, with Dell, Workday and HP set to report Tuesday
